title: Glycemic Variability as an Independent Predictor of All-Cause Mortality in Older Adults During the COVID-19 Pandemic

contributions.purpose: 评估血糖变异性(GV)是否为≥75 岁老人全因死亡的独立预测因子
contributions.mechanism: 对马德里 >500,000 份 EHR(2015-2019/2020-2022)用多变量 Cox 比例风险模型,校正年龄/性别/合并症/用药,并用倾向评分匹配与 IPW
contributions.evaluation: Cox 表:GV 系数 -0.035、HR 0.966、p<0.001;HbA1c 变异 HR 1.048;GV×胰岛素交互 HR 1.015(表内数字与结论相反,见 notes)
contributions.domain: AI 生成流行病学/老年医学
contributions.source_quote: Results demonstrated that higher GV was consistently associated with an increased risk of all-cause mortality, even after accounting for mean glucose levels and other clinical variables.

contributions.purpose: 验证 AI‘虚拟研究团队’能否复现已发表人类研究
contributions.mechanism: 以 Virtual-Lab 策略组织 OpenAI API 虚拟专家 agent,复刻 Salinero-Fort et al. (2024) 同数据集研究作为基准
contributions.evaluation: 定性对比:与人类论文均得出 GV(CV-FPG)与死亡显著相关的结论,但方法细节有别
contributions.source_quote: The goal of this experiment was to assess how a virtual research team would approach such a project—proposing a workflow, developing methodologies, generating results, and drafting a scientific article reviewed by virtual agents.

self_declared_provenance.quote: The reason for selecting this hypothesis was that a paper addressing, and successfully answering, the same question was published by our human research group after the release of the ChatGPT-4o model. This prior publication offered a reliable benchmark against which the model's performance could be validated.

notes: desk-reject,红旗密集。(1)结果表自相矛盾:GV 系数为负、HR 0.966(<1 即‘GV 越高死亡越低’的保护效应),却在正文断言‘higher GV→increased mortality’——表内数字直接推翻自身结论(疑似伪造/误读)。(2)方法不一致:正文对比段称本文‘relies on a straightforward logistic regression’,而方法/结果用的是 Cox 模型。(3)标准误异常之小(0.002-0.007),所有变量 p<0.001。(4)AI 自我披露幻觉:checklist 承认‘references generated based on similarity… rather than deriving claims from cited sources’,并‘uncertainty whether the conclusions result from genuine evaluation… or from claims embedded in the model's training corpus’——即引文与推理可能是编造。(5)循环自证:用已知已发表结果反过来‘验证’AI,数据‘upon request’。checklist:分析/写作自评 [D](AI 主导)。
